content: With regard to the tags themselves, we conjecture that the taxonomy of the tags currently in use in many NLP systems is too complex to be utilized effectively in deep neural models, considering the specificity of many tag sets and the limited amount of data with which to train. Thus, we cluster POS (word-level) tags into 12 groups following the universal POS tagset BIBREF20 and phrase-level tags into 11 groups according to criteria analogous to the case of words, resulting in 23 tag categories in total. In this work, we use the revised coarse-grained tags instead of the original ones. For more details, we refer readers to the supplemental materials.
